checked_sources_new.title: AutoLabs: cognitive multi-agent systems with self-correction for autonomous chemical experimentation
checked_sources_new.type: primary peer-reviewed autonomous-lab agent study with systematic ablations

candidate_mechanisms_new.mechanism: Error-class-specific self-correction routing: route procedural/structural protocol defects through criterion-guided stepwise checks, while routing quantitative calculation defects through a reasoning-capable holistic re-evaluation; evaluate each correction channel on the metric corresponding to the error class rather than using one generic self-review loop.
candidate_mechanisms_new.evidence: AutoLabs evaluates 20 agent configurations across five chemical-protocol benchmarks. Guided self-checks consistently improve protocol-step F1 across architectures, including single-agent configurations without an intrinsic reasoning model. Unguided checks are most effective for chemical-amount errors: relative to baseline they reduce nRMSE by 37% for the non-reasoning single-agent configuration and by >50% for all other tested configurations. But unguided checks can reduce procedural F1 by adding extra water-addition steps, while the authors conclude guided step-by-step criteria are superior for procedural accuracy. The overall best configuration combines multi-agent decomposition with tool use, guided self-correction and full reasoning; on challenging multi-plate syntheses the system reaches F1 > 0.89 against expert reference procedures.
candidate_mechanisms_new.interpretation: Self-correction should be typed by observable failure class. A single open-ended reflection can improve one dimension while degrading another. For scientist agents, review findings should therefore carry a defect type and route to a verifier/repair operator with an aligned metric and post-repair check.
candidate_mechanisms_new.scope: Direct evidence is natural-language-to-hardware-ready chemical protocol generation on five Big-Kahuna liquid-handler benchmark experiments, not hypothesis truth or open-ended discovery quality. Unguided checks use a reasoning model, so their nRMSE gains cannot be attributed to 'unguidedness' alone. The exact guided checklist and model choices are system-specific.

negative_and_boundary_evidence_new: More self-correction is not monotonically better across metrics: AutoLabs reports that unguided self-checks improve quantitative nRMSE but can degrade procedural F1 because the reasoning model introduces unnecessary water-addition steps.
Reasoning capacity is a major confound for unguided-check gains; the paper itself cautions that the reasoning model likely contributes decisively to nRMSE improvement.
Do not generalize AutoLabs' protocol-generation F1/nRMSE gains to scientific hypothesis validity, empirical discovery, or publication correctness without separate evidence.
evidence_refinements: Candidate 027 review closure can incorporate candidate 034 as a repair-router: once a severe finding is durable, classify whether it is procedural, quantitative, evidential/independence, statistical, or claim-scope related; select a correction channel that has an aligned verifier rather than reusing one generic reflection prompt.

AutoLabs supplies a physical-laboratory-adjacent non-HPO matched ablation for self-correction, partially filling the prior frontier for empirical lab-agent mechanisms. It is still protocol-generation benchmarking rather than executed wet-lab outcome optimization.
frontier_additions: Extract supporting-table cell values for AutoLabs guided-self-check F1 changes by architecture/experiment to separate average effects from task-specific regressions.

Search autonomous scientist systems for an analogous typed repair router across evidential/statistical/hypothesis-level defects, ideally with matched ablation and final scientific-artifact validity outcomes.
Test whether a durable review-closure state machine plus error-class-specific repair routing avoids the cross-metric regressions seen with generic holistic self-checks.

termination_diagnostics.blocker: No matched open-ended scientific-claim intervention yet isolates mandatory evidence-changing repair plus cross-artifact reconciliation; AutoLabs directly supports typed self-correction only for protocol generation.
termination_diagnostics.termination_cause: checkpoint after adding primary peer-reviewed non-HPO self-correction ablation evidence; frontier remains nonempty

exact_next_action: Continue source-qualified search for matched open-ended scientist-agent interventions that enforce evidence-changing repair after critique; extract AutoLabs configuration-level guided-check effects if possible, and continue deterministic review-closure sampling without crossing the clean independence boundary.
